role: Descriptive report of the fixed six-arm inner phonetic-continuation study
reportingDeclaredAfter: Prepared after the all-age head-only result was observed and before all six arms completed. At the last observation when this reader was requested, all-age upper1-lr1e-6 was still running and the other four arms were pending. Score definitions already existed in the fixed trainer. This is a descriptive reporting specification, not a new prospective efficacy protocol.
requiredScope: Fold0 inner validation only, original fixed all-age and ages6-12 fitting populations
rankingAggregation: Equal phone weight, excluding phones without both positive and negative rater support; preserve support and undefined values
comparisons: Each arm versus its own raw epoch-zero checkpoint and the same-regime same-fit prior; each upper-layer arm additionally versus the selected same-regime head-only control. Record numerical differences between the arms' starting predictions. Do not rank or select a new winner.
differenceConvention: Model minus reference: lower proper losses and higher AUROC/AP are favorable. Always retain the signed differences, including regressions.
requiredVerification: Caller-pinned completed queue ledger; fixed plan/preflight/source contract; every completed trainer report/history/checkpoint and same-device exact replay; recompute selected, epoch-zero and prior metrics from saved probabilities; rehash all captured inputs/outputs before publication
limitations: One development inner fold and one seed; no new generalization, significance or calibration claim
All-age and child-only epoch selection use different declared populations; compare controls within each regime
This is subjective corpus-rating prediction, not produced-phone recognition or clinical pronunciation judgment
Epoch zero remains eligible; a selected epoch-zero result does not establish a benefit from encoder adaptation
No ages2-5 or verified child speech-sound-disorder evaluation
